sloka: भर्तारं तमपश्यन्ती राक्षसीवशमागता ।सीदामि खलु शोकेन कूलं तोयहतं यथा ।। ५.२३.१५।।।।
transliteration: bhartāraṁ tamapaśyantī rākṣasīvaśamāgatā ।sīdāmi khalu śokena kūlaṁ toyahataṁ yathā ।। 5.23.15।।।।

translations.english: Another ogress called Vikata said, ' Know that he who has often defeated gods in war and has vanquished nagas, gandharvas and demons has come to you (seeking your favour)'.
